div.div:
Code Sheet & Label Format (Sec 6.2):
• Sheet Margin: Batch ID, allocation (farm or center reserve), print timestamp, operator ID, 'Sheet n of m'.
• Each Label: QR code (https:///s/XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXC), human Crockford Base32 code, 'Consulta del saco'.
• Zero personal data, farm name, weight, or date printed on label! (A09 sec 8.1)

div.div:
THE FOUR AUTHORIZED DATA GROUPS RETURNED TO BUYER (ASM-096, SEC 8.2):
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1. Origin: sack_code, department, municipality
2. Processing Dates: drying_start_date, drying_end_date, packing_date (calendar dates, no time of day)
3. Status: current Part C state only (in preparation, in transit to center, at center, in transit to port, delivered at port)
4. Drying Variables: final_coffee_moisture_pct, grain_temperature_min_c, grain_temperature_mean_c, grain_temperature_max_c

div.div:
SECURITY & PRIVACY BOUNDARY: FIELDS THE BUYER VIEW NEVER RETURNS (DOCS SEC 8.3, CASE STATEMENT POINT 2)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
• NO Personal Data: Farmer name, cédula (national ID), phone number, or subject_id are NEVER returned. Point 2 strictly forbids exposing farmer cédula to the buyer.
• NO Geographic Identifiers: Farm name, farm ID, vereda, polygon coordinates, or plot boundaries are NEVER returned (prevents locating or identifying the producer).
• NO Telemetry Series: Farm IoT node identifiers, device X.509 certificates, and raw sensor readings series are completely withheld.
• NO Custody Trace: Transporter identity, vehicle plate, GPS transit points, event timestamps, receiver references, and receiving operator IDs are withheld.
• NO Commercial Details: Collection center name, rejection reasons, sack scale weights, and internal sack_id are NEVER exposed to the public view.
• Uniform Error Response: Malformed check symbols, void codes, unknown codes, and unregistered codes return identical 'not found' status (zero enumeration oracle).
